originalActualFindings.actualVerbatimFinding: Medium; C1/C3; kanji/成.md front-matter title and H1: «совершаться» can suggest occurring/being carried out rather than 成る «становиться/получаться» and 成す «достигать результата/совершать», so learners may mislearn the basic sense. Change the second gloss to «достигать результата» (or similarly distinguish accomplishment from becoming). Evidence: captured KanjiPedia defines なる／できあがる, なす／なしとげる and そだつ; KANJIDIC2 lists become/turn into/reach/accomplish/grow; JMdict 1375610 and 1375690. Confidence: medium-high.
